name: Outbound message guardrail
description: Check a drafted message before it is sent.
use_when: On every AI written message, email or text, as the last step before sending. Hold anything that fails and show it to a person.

unsupported_claim.instructions: The message states a result, number or fact about the recipient or about us that could be invented

personal_detail_risk.instructions: The message mentions a personal detail about the recipient that is not in the given facts

aggressive_tone.instructions: How pushy or aggressive the message sounds

promises_results.instructions: The message guarantees a result or makes a promise we may not keep
